phase.briefing: There is a Zion assassin known as Alhena who has been the source of much grief for us. Before they can make another assassination attempt, we would rather have Alhena killed. Go to this location and kill Alhena.

enter.say: That's strange ... I don't see Alhena's signal here. Proceed with caution.

phase.briefing: I want you to speak with Halloran, he is the program that gave us the tip off on Alhena's location which turned out to be incorrect. Meet up with Halloran and see if he can shed some new light on this situation.
You should have the new location now.

enter.say: This has to be the location of the Zion assassin.
